title: Device mockup generator — iPhone, Galaxy, iPad & Mac in 3D · Drisp
excerpt: Drop an app or website screenshot, get an iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, iPad, Mac or watch mockup with real glass and light. Free, no new account — and an MCP server for Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT.
content_html:
Device mockups · real 3D

Your screenshot, on a real device.

Drop an app or website screenshot, get an iPhone, Galaxy, Pixel, iPad, Mac, watch or monitor with real glass and studio light — drawn by Drint’s 3D engine, not pasted on a photo. For App Store and Google Play pages, landing heroes, decks and launch posts.

Real glass. Real light.

  • Not a flat frameThe device is a 3D model: the screen catches the studio light like real glass.
  • Day-one devicesScreen sizes change every year; Drisp models new ones from the published dimensions.
  • Clean exportsPNG on studio grey, white or transparent, ready for a store page or a hero.

Mockups from your editor.

Add the Drisp MCP server to Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT or any MCP client, then ask for the mockup in plain words. list_devices gives each screen’s exact screenshot size; device_mockup returns the PNG.

App Store and Google Play screenshot sets, in each store’s required sizes: make a set.

MCP

// claude_desktop_config.json, .cursor/mcp.json…
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "drisp": { "url": "https://drint.io/drisp/mcp" }
  }
}

Claude Code

› Put screenshots/home.png on a phone, transparent background.

device_mockup({
  "device": "phone",
  "screenshot_url": "https://…/home.png",
  "background": "transparent"
})
→ PNG, 1024 × 1024 · drint.io/drisp/phone

Questions

What screenshot size should I upload?

Any PNG, JPEG or WebP works. For a pixel-perfect fit use the size shown on each device page — the screenshot fills the screen edge to edge and is cropped from the centre if its proportions differ.

Are the devices real 3D?

Yes. Every device is a 3D model drawn with real glass, reflections and studio light by the same engine that renders Drint’s packaging mockups — not a flat frame pasted on a photo.

Can I use it from Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT?

Yes. Add the Drisp MCP server (drint.io/drisp/mcp) and ask for “my app screenshot on a phone”. The device_mockup tool returns a PNG.

Do I need a new account?

No. Drisp uses your Drint account — sign in once, the same login works for both.
